// ---------- relevo: x = leste (baía), z = sul ----------
const coastX=z=>44+5*Math.sin(z*.025);
function plateau(x,z,cx,cz,r,h,flat){const d=Math.hypot(x-cx,z-cz)/r;if(d>=1)return 0;let s=d<=flat?1:(1-d)/(1-flat);s=s*s*(3-2*s);return h*s;}
const CAST={x:15,z:82},SBENTO={x:0,z:-84};
function H(x,z){
  const cx=coastX(z);
  const base=x<cx?.3:.3-Math.min(5,(x-cx)*.6);
  return base+plateau(x,z,CAST.x,CAST.z,30,20,.42)+plateau(x,z,SBENTO.x,SBENTO.z,22,13,.35)+plateau(x,z,-78,30,18,10,.3)
   +plateau(x,z,-210,30,120,75,0)+plateau(x,z,-160,170,80,110,0)+plateau(x,z,-70,-230,130,55,0)+plateau(x,z,-170,-130,90,50,0)
   +.25*Math.sin(x*.05)*Math.cos(z*.07)*(x<cx-4?1:0);
}
function segDist(px,pz,a,b){const vx=b[0]-a[0],vz=b[1]-a[1];let t=((px-a[0])*vx+(pz-a[1])*vz)/(vx*vx+vz*vz);t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return Math.hypot(px-a[0]-vx*t,pz-a[1]-vz*t);}

function mergeGeos(list){const pos=[],nor=[],uv=[];list.forEach(([g,m])=>{const q=g.index?g.toNonIndexed():g.clone();q.applyMatrix4(m);
  pos.push(q.attributes.position.array);nor.push(q.attributes.normal.array);uv.push(q.attributes.uv?q.attributes.uv.array:new Float32Array(q.attributes.position.count*2));});
  const cat=a=>{let n=0;a.forEach(x=>n+=x.length);const r=new Float32Array(n);let k=0;a.forEach(x=>{r.set(x,k);k+=x.length;});return r;};
  const out=new THREE.BufferGeometry();out.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(cat(pos),3));out.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.BufferAttribute(cat(nor),3));out.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.BufferAttribute(cat(uv),2));return out;}
function smoothNormals(g){const q=g.attributes.position,n=q.count,acc=new Map(),key=i=>(Math.round(q.getX(i)*1e3))+','+(Math.round(q.getY(i)*1e3))+','+(Math.round(q.getZ(i)*1e3));
  const a=new THREE.Vector3(),b=new THREE.Vector3(),c=new THREE.Vector3(),fn=new THREE.Vector3();
  for(let i=0;i<n;i+=3){a.fromBufferAttribute(q,i);b.fromBufferAttribute(q,i+1);c.fromBufferAttribute(q,i+2);fn.subVectors(c,b).cross(a.clone().sub(b));
    for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const kk=key(i+k);const v=acc.get(kk)||new THREE.Vector3();v.add(fn);acc.set(kk,v);}}
  const nor=new Float32Array(n*3);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const v=acc.get(key(i)).clone().normalize();nor[i*3]=v.x;nor[i*3+1]=v.y;nor[i*3+2]=v.z;}
  g.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.BufferAttribute(nor,3));return g;}
function bumpy(g,amp,f){const q=g.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<q.count;i++){const x=q.getX(i),y=q.getY(i),z=q.getZ(i);
  const n=1+amp*(Math.sin(x*f+y*1.3)*Math.cos(z*f*1.1-x*.7)+.5*Math.sin(y*f*2.1+z*1.9));q.setXYZ(i,x*n,y*n,z*n);}if(g.index)g.computeVertexNormals();else smoothNormals(g);return g;}

// ---------- sobrado colonial ----------
const WALLS=[0xf6f1e6,0xf2e2bf,0xeed6a0,0xdfe8ec,0xf3d8cc,0xf6f1e6,0xe9e1cc,0xd9e4cf];
const FRAMES=[0x2f5f8a,0x3f6e3c,0x7a2f25,0x2f5f8a,0x5a3a22,0x1f4a6a,0x3d5a3a];
const M_BARRADO=mat(0x9b8d76,TEX.stone),M_CAL=mat(0xf8f5ee);
function sobrado(x,z,rot,o={}){
  const w=o.w||7,d=o.d||8,fl=o.floors||2,h=fl*3.4+.6;
  const g=groupAt(x,z,rot,(o.y??H(x,z))-.2);
  const wallMat=mat(o.wall||WALLS[Math.floor(rnd()*WALLS.length)],TEX.plaster);
  if(o.openDoor){const gap=2.12,sideW=(w-gap)/2;
    for(const side of [-1,1]){occluders.push(box(sideW,h,d,wallMat,side*(gap/2+sideW/2),h/2,0,g));box(sideW+.035,.88,d+.06,M_BARRADO,side*(gap/2+sideW/2),.44,0,g,false);}
    occluders.push(box(gap,h-2.85,d,wallMat,0,2.85+(h-2.85)/2,0,g));
    box(gap,2.72,.18,mat(0x3b2e25),0,1.36,d/2-1.65,g,false);box(gap,.12,1.72,M.wood,0,.11,d/2-.82,g,false);
  }else{const wall=box(w,h,d,wallMat,0,h/2,0,g);occluders.push(wall);box(w+.1,1,d+.1,M_BARRADO,0,.5,0,g,false);}                                     // barrado de pedra
  for(const s of[-1,1])box(.48,h,.48,M.stone,s*(w/2-.16),h/2,d/2-.16,g,false);    // cunhais
  box(w+.36,.32,d+.36,M_CAL,0,h-.1,0,g,false);                                      // cornija
  box(w+1.2,.14,d+1.6,M_CAL,0,h+.12,0,g,false);                                     // beiral
  if(fl>1)box(w+.12,.16,.22,M_CAL,0,3.55,d/2+.06,g,false);                           // friso entre os andares
  const fr=o.frame||FRAMES[Math.floor(rnd()*FRAMES.length)];
  const n=o.n||Math.max(2,Math.floor(w/2.3)),door=o.door??Math.floor(n/2);
  for(let f=0;f<fl;f++)for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const wx=-w/2+(i+.5)*w/n,isDoor=f===0&&i===door;
    if(isDoor){V23.reg(g,wx,d/2);const dh=o.openDoor?2.62:2.45+rnd()*.4;if(o.openDoor){for(const side of [-1,1]){box(.15,2.82,.45,M.stone,wx+side*1.12,1.41,d/2+.04,g);const leaf=new THREE.Group();leaf.position.set(wx+side*1.02,.12,d/2+.1);leaf.rotation.y=-side*Math.PI/2;g.add(leaf);box(.97,dh,.11,mat(fr,TEX.wood),-side*.485,dh/2,0,leaf);for(const yy of [.55,1.5,2.15])box(.68,.07,.08,mat(0x6e553c),-side*.415,yy,.08,leaf,false);}}else{const dw=1.35+rnd()*.25;if(!o.bigDoor)V23.list[V23.list.length-1].dd=V23.door(g,fr,dw,dh,wx,.18,d/2+.03);}if(rnd()<.5)box(1.9,.14,.16,M.stone,wx,dh+.25,d/2+.1,g,false);continue;}
    if(f===0){facePlane(winMat(fr,'low'),1.15,1.45,wx,2.05,d/2+.03,g);continue;}
    const wy=f*3.4+1.95,bal=o.balcony!==false;
    facePlane(winMat(fr,bal?'sacada':'low'),1.2,bal?1.95:1.45,wx,wy,d/2+.03,g);
    if(bal){box(1.7,.12,.62,M.stone,wx,f*3.4+.88,d/2+.3,g,false);
      facePlane(RAIL,1.62,.7,wx,f*3.4+1.28,d/2+.6,g);
      if(rnd()<.45)facePlane(COLCHAS[Math.floor(rnd()*COLCHAS.length)],1.4,1.6,wx,f*3.4+.95,d/2+.64,g);}
    if(f===fl-1&&rnd()<.55){const lp=new THREE.Mesh(LAMPG,LAMPM);lp.position.set(wx,wy-.35,d/2+.25);lp.visible=false;g.add(lp);LAMPS.push(lp);}
  }

    for(const side of [-1,1])part(side*(gap/2+sw/2),0,sw,d);part(0,-.85,gap,d-1.7);
  }else addCollider(x,z,w,d,rot);
  return g;
}

function church(x,z,rot,o={}){
  const L=o.L||20,W=o.W||10,Hn=o.H||9,g=groupAt(x,z,rot,(o.y??H(x,z))-.2);
  const wm=mat(o.wall||0xf8f4ea,TEX.plaster),st=M.stone,mould=mat(0xd5c6ad,TEX.stone);
  occluders.push(box(W,Hn,L,wm,0,Hn/2,0,g));
  box(W+.1,1.1,L+.1,M_BARRADO,0,.55,0,g,false);
  const r=new THREE.Mesh(gableGeo(L+.4,W+1.4,3),M.tile);r.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;r.position.set(0,Hn,0);add(r,g);
  for(const s of[-1,1])box(.3,.22,L+.6,M_CAL,s*(W/2+.55),Hn+.05,0,g,false);                       // beirais laterais
  const fz=L/2+.3,ff=fz+.5;occluders.push(box(W+.4,Hn+3,1,wm,0,(Hn+3)/2,fz,g));
  // frontão barroco com moldura de cantaria (V20), no lugar do triângulo simples
  V20.frontao(W/2+.1,Math.min(3.6,W*.36),1,wm,mould,0,Hn+2.95,fz,g);
  // pilastras com base e capitel; entablamento em degraus
  for(const s of[-1,-.33,.33,1]){const px=s*(W/2-.1);box(.6,Hn+3,.3,st,px,(Hn+3)/2,fz+.55,g,false);
    box(.82,.55,.48,mould,px,.42,fz+.6,g,false);box(.86,.22,.5,mould,px,Hn+2.72,fz+.62,g,false);box(.74,.16,.44,mould,px,Hn+2.52,fz+.6,g,false);}

  for(const s of[-1,1]){const tx=s*(W/2+1.5),tz=fz-1,TH=Hn+8;
    box(3,TH,3,wm,tx,TH/2,tz,g);
    for(const sx of[-1,1])for(const sz of[-1,1])box(.42,TH,.42,st,tx+sx*1.42,TH/2,tz+sz*1.42,g,false);   // cunhais
    V20.cornice(3.1,3.1,Hn+3.05,mould,g,tx,tz);V20.cornice(3.2,3.2,TH-.25,mould,g,tx,tz);
    const bellY=Hn+4.5;
    for(const [fx,fzz,ry,bell] of [[0,1.5,0,true],[s*1.5,0,s*Math.PI/2,true],[-s*1.5,0,-s*Math.PI/2,false],[0,-1.5,Math.PI,false]]){
      const ox=tx+fx*1.0,oz=tz+fzz*1.0,nx=Math.sin(ry),nz=Math.cos(ry);
      V20.hole(1.5,2.6,ox+nx*.02,bellY,oz+nz*.02,g,ry);

      box(2.3,.16,.36,mould,ox+nx*.12,bellY-.12,oz+nz*.12,g,false).rotation.y=ry;
      if(bell){const b=new THREE.Mesh(V20.cache('bell',()=>new THREE.LatheGeometry([[0,.62],[.2,.6],[.27,.42],[.32,.12],[.44,0],[.42,-.04]].map(([a,c])=>new THREE.Vector2(a,c)),12)),M.bronze);

  V20.arch(3.6,5.3,.5,.36,st,0,0,ff+.18,g);
  {const dd=V23.door(g,0x5a3a26,2.6,3.4,0,0,ff+.04);V23.reg(g,0,ff+.5);V23.list[V23.list.length-1].dd=dd;}
  {const fan=new THREE.Mesh(V20.cache('fan',()=>new THREE.CircleGeometry(1.3,14,0,Math.PI)),mat(0x2b2018));fan.position.set(0,3.4,ff+.05);g.add(fan);

  for(const s of[-1,1]){facePlane(winMat(0x4a3a2a,'sacada'),1.3,2,s*2.4,6.4,ff+.02,g);V20.arch(1.75,2.5,.22,.2,mould,s*2.4,5.32,ff+.1,g);}
  // óculo (rosácea) com raios de pedra
  const oc=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(.9,16),M.dark);oc.position.set(0,Hn+1.25,ff+.02);g.add(oc);
  const ocr=new THREE.Mesh(V20.cache('ocr',()=>new THREE.TorusGeometry(.95,.16,8,24)),st);ocr.position.set(0,Hn+1.25,ff+.06);g.add(ocr);

  // cruz de pedra no remate do frontão
  {const ty=Hn+2.95+Math.min(3.6,W*.36)+.3;box(.24,1.5,.24,st,0,ty+.75,fz,g);box(.95,.22,.24,st,0,ty+1.05,fz,g);}
  for(const s of[-1,1])for(let i=0;i<3;i++){facePlane(winMat(0x4a3a2a,'sacada'),1.1,1.8,s*(W/2+.02),Hn*.62,-L/2+4+i*5,g).rotation.y=s*Math.PI/2;
    V20.arch(1.5,2.3,.2,.16,mould,s*(W/2+.08),Hn*.62-.95,-L/2+4+i*5,g,s*Math.PI/2);}
  // adro: degraus de cantaria
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++)box(4.6+k*.6,.17,.52,mould,0,.14+k*.13,ff+.75+k*.45,g,false);
  addCollider(x,z,W+6.2,L+1.2,rot);
  return g;
}
// ---------- vegetação: guardada em listas e desenhada de uma vez no fim ----------
const TREES=[],PALMS=[],BANANAS=[];
function tree(x,z,s=1){if(H(x,z)<.1)return;TREES.push([x,z,s]);colliders.push({x,z,r:.4*s});}
function palm(x,z){if(H(x,z)<.1)return;PALMS.push([x,z,.9+rnd()*.35]);colliders.push({x,z,r:.3});}
function banana(x,z){if(H(x,z)<.1)return;BANANAS.push([x,z,.8+rnd()*.4]);}

function rioAnimal(parent,x,z,kind='boi'){

// Objetos e adornos de culturas africanas, inspirados nos achados arqueológicos do Valongo.
// Reconstituição didática (não são réplicas exatas nem itens para pegar de pessoas escravizadas).
const VALONGO_TRACES=[];
function valongoTrace(x,z,kind){
  const g=groupAt(x,z,0,.12),wood=mat(0x735238),brass=mat(0xa87540),ivory=mat(0xf2e5c8),clay=mat(0x8c5f47);
  box(1.95,.16,1.35,wood,0,.88,0,g);for(const xx of[-.77,.77])for(const zz of[-.42,.42])box(.12,.88,.12,wood,xx,.44,zz,g);
  const beadM=[mat(0x335b9b),mat(0xe1ac52),mat(0x9a483a),mat(0xf1e0b8),mat(0x6b7844)];
  if(kind==='contas'){
    // Fio circular de contas coloridas, também nos personagens: identidade, adorno e proteção.
    for(let i=0;i<36;i++){const a=2*Math.PI*i/36,r=.55+.07*Math.cos(a*3),b=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.092,8,6),beadM[i%5]);
      b.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,1.05,Math.sin(a)*r*.75);g.add(b);}
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const e=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.13,8,7),beadM[i%5]);e.position.set(-.65+i*.23,1.11,.44);g.add(e);}
  }else if(kind==='buzios'){
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const xx=-.56+(i%5)*.28,zz=-.25+Math.floor(i/5)*.43;
      const sh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.15,10,7),ivory);sh.scale.set(1,.47,.7);sh.position.set(xx,1.05,zz);g.add(sh);
      const cut=box(.17,.02,.04,clay,xx,1.117,zz,g,false);cut.rotation.y=i*.1;}
    const amulet=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.12,.3,7),brass);amulet.rotation.z=.35;amulet.position.set(.78,1.15,.25);g.add(amulet);
  }else{
    // Cachimbo de barro, pequena cerâmica e bracelete de cobre.
    const bowl=cyl(.31,.24,.28,clay,-.4,1.11,0,g,12);
    const rim=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.27,.04,6,12),ivory);rim.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;rim.position.set(-.4,1.27,0);g.add(rim);
    const stem=cyl(.065,.08,.8,clay,.12,1.15,.08,g,9);stem.rotation.z=-Math.PI/2.8;
    const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.26,.055,6,18),brass);ring.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;ring.position.set(.47,1.09,-.34);g.add(ring);
    const pot=cyl(.29,.21,.41,clay,.58,1.14,.30,g,10);
    box(.24,.08,.15,mat(0xe7c78b),-.5,1.33,.26,g,false);
  }
  VALONGO_TRACES.push({kind,g,x,z});
}

// V13: relevo paisagístico inspirado na Guanabara, sem pretensão cartográfica.
function bayHill(parent,x,z,rx,rz,h,base,rock,seed){
 const geo=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2,64,64);geo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);const p=geo.attributes.position,colors=new Float32Array(p.count*3),c=new THREE.Color();
 for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
  const u=p.getX(i),v=p.getZ(i),r=Math.hypot(u,v),a=Math.atan2(v,u);const edge=1+.075*Math.sin(a*5+seed)+.07*Math.cos(a*3-seed);
  const q=Math.max(0,1-Math.pow(r/edge,rock?.78:1.25));let y=h*Math.pow(q,rock?.54:1.12);
  y*=1+.07*Math.sin(u*19+v*8+seed)*Math.cos(v*12-u*4)*Math.min(1,q*4);
  p.setXYZ(i,u*rx,base+y,v*rz);
  const grit=.5+.5*Math.sin(u*103+v*37+seed)*Math.cos(v*79-u*52);
  if(rock&&q>.31){c.setRGB(.35+grit*.10,.37+grit*.09,.32+grit*.08);}else{c.setRGB(.13+grit*.09,.27+grit*.13,.15+grit*.07);}
  if(q<.065)c.setRGB(.54,.52,.37);colors.set([c.r,c.g,c.b],i*3);
 }
 geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));geo.computeVertexNormals();const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.94}));m.position.set(x,0,z);parent.add(m);return m;
}
// O perfil do Pão de Açúcar e do Morro da Urca estrutura a entrada da baía.
// Rio 1808 — Three.js r128. Relevo interpretativo; origem local na Urca, Y vertical.
function createRioSugarloaf(THREE, options={}) {
 const root=new THREE.Group();root.name='Rio_Pao_de_Acucar_Urca_v40';
 const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));const mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
 const smooth=(a,b,x)=>{const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
 const noise=(x,z)=>Math.sin(x*.42+Math.sin(z*.23)*1.7)*Math.cos(z*.35+Math.sin(x*.18)*1.8)*.55+Math.sin(x*.91-z*.73)*Math.cos(z*1.13+x*.51)*.27+Math.sin(x*2.4+z*1.9)*.18;
 const pProfile=[[0,1],[.07,.994],[.18,.975],[.32,.925],[.46,.83],[.59,.66],[.70,.44],[.82,.21],[.94,.045],[1,0]];
 const uProfile=[[0,1],[.13,.993],[.27,.966],[.41,.87],[.58,.66],[.72,.41],[.85,.16],[.95,.045],[1,0]];
 function profile(r,p){if(r>=1)return 0;for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++){if(r<=p[i][0]){const t=(r-p[i-1][0])/(p[i][0]-p[i-1][0]);return mix(p[i-1][1],p[i][1],t);}}return 0;}
 function peak(x,z,cx,cz,rx,rz,h,prof,kind){let u=(x-cx)/rx,v=(z-cz)/rz;const t=clamp(Math.hypot(u,v));if(kind==='p'){u-=.13*(1-t);v+=.10*(1-t);}else{u+=.10*(1-t);v-=.06*(1-t);}const a=Math.atan2(v,u);const e=1+.105*Math.cos(a*2+.45)+.075*Math.sin(a*3-1.4)+.037*Math.cos(a*5+.9)+(kind==='p'?.13*Math.sin(a+.5):.10*Math.cos(a-.4));const r=Math.hypot(u,v)/e,q=profile(r,prof);const n=noise(x*.68,z*.68);return h*q+(kind==='p'?1.6:1.9)*n*Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*smooth(0,.09,q);}
 function height(x,z){const p=peak(x,z,43,13,36,37,83,pProfile,'p');const u=peak(x,z,0,0,44,33,47.4,uProfile,'u');const a=.293,dx=x-21,dz=z-6.5,along=dx*Math.cos(a)+dz*Math.sin(a),cross=-dx*Math.sin(a)+dz*Math.cos(a);const rr=Math.hypot(along/58,cross/30),ridge=28*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-rr*rr),1.35);const sm=(a,b,k)=>{const t=Math.max(k-Math.abs(a-b),0)/k;return Math.max(a,b)+t*t*k*.25;};const h=sm(sm(p,u,3.2),ridge,2.2);return Math.max(0,h-.6)-3.1;}
 function cover(x,z,y){const dx=(height(x+.6,z)-height(x-.6,z))/1.2,dz=(height(x,z+.6)-height(x,z-.6))/1.2;const slope=Math.hypot(dx,dz),p=Math.hypot((x-43)/32,(z-13)/35),u=Math.hypot(x/39,z/29);const n=noise(x*.84,z*.84);const a=Math.atan2(z-13,x-43),face=.5+.5*Math.cos(a+2.0);let rock=0;if(p<1.07&&y>15){const mask=.40+.60*face;rock=smooth(.65,2.0,slope+.7*n)*smooth(15,41,y)*mask;rock=Math.max(rock,smooth(30,60,y)*smooth(.13,.54,p)*(.36+.56*face));}if(u<1.10&&y<48){const au=Math.atan2(z,x),faceU=Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.cos(au-.65)),2);rock=Math.max(rock,.95*faceU*smooth(.60,1.8,slope+.6*n)*smooth(9,20,y));}rock*=1-.68*smooth(.10,.75,n);if(p<.19&&y>73)rock*=.55+.24*smooth(.04,.19,p);if(n>.52)rock*=.72;const shore=(1-smooth(-.8,5.0,y))*smooth(-3,0,y);return {rock:clamp(rock),shore:clamp(shore),n,slope};}
 const geo=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(145,103,128,92);geo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);geo.translate(20,0,5);const pos=geo.attributes.position,colors=new Float32Array(pos.count*3);
 const green=[.036,.092,.028],green2=[.105,.205,.055],stone=[.20,.18,.155],stone2=[.38,.34,.28],shore=[.33,.29,.20];
 for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){const x=pos.getX(i),z=pos.getZ(i),y=height(x,z),m=cover(x,z,y);pos.setY(i,y);const a=Math.atan2(z-13,x-43),fiss=.5+.5*Math.sin(a*37+Math.sin(y*.075)*1.3+noise(x*.36,z*.36)*.45);const streak=Math.pow(fiss,6),grain=clamp(.48+m.n*.40+.13*Math.sin(x*4.3+z*3.9));const rockShade=clamp(.53+m.n*.43-streak*.65);for(let j=0;j<3;j++)colors[i*3+j]=mix(mix(mix(green[j],green2[j],grain),mix(stone[j],stone2[j],rockShade),m.rock),shore[j],m.shore*.65);}
 geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors,3));geo.computeVertexNormals();geo.computeBoundingSphere();const terrain=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:1,metalness:0}));terrain.name='Relevo_continuo_gnaisse_e_Mata_Atlantica';root.add(terrain);
 let seed=7193;const rnd=()=>{seed=(seed*16807)%2147483647;return seed/2147483647;};const leaf=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0);const leafPos=leaf.attributes.position.array;const pp=[],cc=[];let count=0;
 for(let attempt=0;attempt<7000&&count<780;attempt++){const x=-43+rnd()*125,z=-32+rnd()*77,y=height(x,z),m=cover(x,z,y);if(y<1.4||m.rock>.44||m.slope>3.4||rnd()<.30)continue;const s=.40+rnd()*.75,sy=s*(.68+rnd()*.37),ang=rnd()*6.283,co=Math.cos(ang),si=Math.sin(ang),tone=rnd();for(let j=0;j<leafPos.length;j+=3){const vx=leafPos[j],vy=leafPos[j+1],vz=leafPos[j+2];pp.push(x+(vx*co-vz*si)*s,y+sy*.60+vy*sy,z+(vx*si+vz*co)*s);cc.push(.036+tone*.06,.10+tone*.12,.027+tone*.035);}count++;}
 const forestGeo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();forestGeo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pp,3));forestGeo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(cc,3));forestGeo.computeVertexNormals();forestGeo.computeBoundingSphere();leaf.dispose();const forest=new THREE.Mesh(forestGeo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:1,flatShading:true}));forest.name='Copas_rupicolas_e_floresta';root.add(forest);
 root.position.set(options.x??133,options.seaY??-.9,options.z??150);root.rotation.y=options.rotation??0;root.scale.setScalar(options.scale??1);root.userData={version:'v40-relevo-interpretativo',trees:count,seaY:options.seaY??-.9,notes:'Sem DEM validado; não é restituição topográfica métrica.'};return root;
}

// ---------- calçamento: pé-de-moleque no Largo e na Rua Direita, terra batida nas outras ruas ----------
function drapeStrip(a,b,wid,m,rx){const dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1],len=Math.hypot(dx,dz),ux=dx/len,uz=dz/len;
  const g=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(wid,len,2,Math.max(2,Math.ceil(len/2)));const q=g.attributes.position,uv=g.attributes.uv;
  for(let i=0;i<q.count;i++){const lx=q.getX(i),ly=q.getY(i)+len/2;const wx=a[0]+ux*ly-uz*lx,wz=a[1]+uz*ly+ux*lx;q.setXYZ(i,wx,H(wx,wz)+.06,wz);uv.setXY(i,(lx/wid+.5)*wid/rx,ly/rx);}
  g.computeVertexNormals();const me=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);me.receiveShadow=true;scene.add(me);return me;}
{ const cob=TEX.cobble.clone();cob.needsUpdate=true;cob.repeat.set(1,1);
  const MC=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xcfc2a8,map:cob,bumpMap:cob,bumpScale:.1,roughness:.95,polygonOffset:true,polygonOffsetFactor:-2});
  const dirt=TEX.dirt.clone();dirt.needsUpdate=true;
  const MD=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xcbb898,map:dirt,bumpMap:dirt,bumpScale:.045,roughness:1,polygonOffset:true,polygonOffsetFactor:-1});
  drapeStrip([22.5,-19],[22.5,19],37,MC,2.6);                       // Largo do Paço
  drapeStrip([0,-64],[0,54],6.4,MC,2.6);                            // Rua Direita
  for(const r of ROADS.slice(1))drapeStrip(r[0],r[1],5.4,MD,5);}

// Telhas curvas low poly em InstancedMesh: relevo real, sem milhares de draw calls.
function addRoofTiles(){
  const tiles=[];
  for(const r of LP_ROOF_DETAILS){
    const half=(r.d+1.8)/2,roofRise=2.5;
    const stepX=LP_SMALL?1.2:.83,stepZ=LP_SMALL?.96:.63;
    for(let lx=-(r.w+.8)/2+stepX/2;lx<(r.w+.8)/2;lx+=stepX)
      for(const side of[-1,1])for(let q=.5;q<half/stepZ;q++){
        const z=side*q*stepZ,yy=r.y+r.h+.2+roofRise*(1-Math.abs(z)/half)+.10;
        const cs=Math.cos(r.rot),sn=Math.sin(r.rot);
        tiles.push({x:r.x+lx*cs+z*sn,y:yy,z:r.z-lx*sn+z*cs,rot:r.rot,tilt:side*Math.atan(roofRise/half),shade:Math.floor(Math.abs(lx*7+q*13+r.x*3))%5});
      }
  }
  if(!tiles.length)return;
  const geometry=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(LP_SMALL?.51:.35,LP_SMALL?.51:.35,LP_SMALL?.93:.59,10,1,true,0,Math.PI);geometry.rotateX(Math.PI/2);geometry.scale(1,.24,1);
  const material=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xffffff,roughness:.97,flatShading:true});
  const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry,material,tiles.length),m=new THREE.Object3D(),c=new THREE.Color();
  const colors=[0xaa593b,0xba6943,0xc57a51,0x9a5039,0xd18b5d];
  tiles.forEach((t,i)=>{m.position.set(t.x,t.y,t.z);m.rotation.set(0,t.rot,0);
    const turn=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0),t.tilt);
    m.quaternion.multiply(turn);m.updateMatrix();mesh.setMatrixAt(i,m.matrix);mesh.setColorAt(i,c.setHex(colors[t.shade]));});
  mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;mesh.castShadow=!LP_SMALL;
  scene.add(mesh);
}
addRoofTiles();

// Rounded, tapered hull shared by the fleet, canoes and royal barge.
function boatHull(parent,w,l,h,y,color){
  const stations=[[-.5,.30],[-.44,.76],[-.28,.98],[0,1],[.28,.88],[.43,.50],[.52,.025]];
  const verts=[],indices=[];
  for(const [z,k] of stations){
    for(const [xx,yy] of [[-1,1],[-.91,.64],[-.57,.12],[0,0],[.57,.12],[.91,.64],[1,1]])verts.push(xx*w*.5*k,y+yy*h,z*l);
  }
  for(let j=0;j<stations.length-1;j++)for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const a=j*7+i,b=a+7;indices.push(a,b,a+1,b,b+1,a+1);}
  indices.push(0,3,6,42,48,45);
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(verts,3));const uvs=[];for(let j=0;j<stations.length;j++)for(let i=0;i<7;i++)uvs.push((stations[j][0]+.5)*3,i/6);geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs,2));geo.setIndex(indices);geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat(color,TEX.wood,{side:THREE.DoubleSide}));parent.add(mesh);mesh.receiveShadow=true;
  const outline=stations.map(([z,k])=>new THREE.Vector2(w*.5*k,z*l));
  const shape=new THREE.Shape();shape.moveTo(outline[0].x,outline[0].y);for(const v of outline.slice(1))shape.lineTo(v.x,v.y);for(const v of outline.slice().reverse())shape.lineTo(-v.x,v.y);shape.closePath();
  const dg=new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shape);const du=dg.attributes.uv,dp=dg.attributes.position;for(let k=0;k<du.count;k++)du.setXY(k,(dp.getX(k)+w/2)/Math.max(w,.01),(dp.getY(k)+l/2)/Math.max(l,.01));const deck=new THREE.Mesh(dg,mat(0xc4ad85,TEX.planks,{side:THREE.DoubleSide}));deck.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;deck.position.y=y+h-.06;parent.add(deck);
  for(const side of [-1,1])for(const level of [.37,.57,.75,.91,1.02]){
    const points=stations.map(([z,k])=>new THREE.Vector3(side*w*.5*k*(level===.75?.96:1),y+h*level,z*l));
    parent.add(new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points),new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xd0ac64})));
  }
}

function clothGeo(profile,folds,amp,seg=24,phiStart=0,phiLen=Math.PI*2){
  const g=new THREE.LatheGeometry(profile.map(([r,y])=>new THREE.Vector2(r,y)),seg,phiStart,phiLen);
  const q=g.attributes.position,yT=Math.max(...profile.map(p=>p[1])),yB=Math.min(...profile.map(p=>p[1]));
  for(let i=0;i<q.count;i++){const x=q.getX(i),y=q.getY(i),z=q.getZ(i),th=Math.atan2(x,z),k=Math.pow(Math.max(0,(yT-y)/(yT-yB)),1.2);
    const f=1+amp*k*(Math.sin(th*folds)*.7+Math.sin(th*folds*2.3+1.7)*.3);q.setX(i,x*f);q.setZ(i,z*f);}
  g.computeVertexNormals();return g;}
